about_the_game:
You're collecting clues in the bustling rainy city of Grand Fir Village. It ain't easy. You need to get sharp skills, fresh ideas, good friends. What will get in your way? Neon-soaked nightmares? Fashionable falsehoods? Apocalyptic apathy? Or your own super-dark, super-cool sunglasses?

Sometimes the only solution, is an 80s-groove, a smooth mocktail, and a trusted confidant. Whatever tech magnates have up their sleeves, you and your friends can handle it. Because if WE don't invent it? Something else, will invent IT onto us.

Get ready to dream big and act bolder. There's no place left to hide...

We dare you to hide something so wonderful.

... Love You! XOXO

ALBUM PACKAGE INCLUDES:

  • 80s dream-wave and dance-pop written originally for Grand Fir Village

  • Performed by real humans who performed analog music in the real 80s

  • High-fidelity .MP3s and .WAV of the NeonSynth game Soundtrack

  • Twenty-three lyric sheets for each of the songs

  • Twenty original desktop wallpapers of NeonSynth Grand Fir Village
